name: Murfreesboro
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Murfreesboro for 2026, and here is what he found: 10 family events, 4 of them free. The magic runs from November 20 (Winterfest Ice Skating at Fountains at Gateway) through January 31, 2027, with Holly Jolly Festival of Lights at Lucky Ladd Farms (from November 27), the Celebrate Christmas Downtown tree lighting (December 4), the Murfreesboro Christmas Parade (December 13) and The Nutcracker at Hinton Hall (December 19 and 20) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Murfreesboro

  • 10 Christmas events for kids in Murfreesboro
  • 4 free events, including the downtown tree lighting, free photos with Santa at the courthouse, the Christmas Parade and Santa events at Stones River Town Centre
  • Meet Santa: free photos at the Rutherford County Courthouse (December 4, 5 and 12), Santa's Arrival and Fun with Santa at Stones River Town Centre, and Santa at Lucky Ladd Farms
  • Parades and tree lightings: Celebrate Christmas Downtown (December 4) and the Murfreesboro Christmas Parade (December 13)
  • Also new: Winterfest ice skating, A Charming Christmas at Cannonsburgh Village, The Nutcracker and the Oaklands Candlelight Tour of Homes
  • Season: November 20, 2026 to January 31, 2027

Planning a bigger day out? Murfreesboro families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Nashville, which covers ICE at Gaylord Opryland, Glow Wild at Nashville Zoo, Holiday LIGHTS at Cheekwood and the Santa Express train at Tennessee Central Railway Museum.
